data.one_liner: A customizable bubble-shaped container widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a container with a speech‑bubble shape that can be styled with borders, gradients, dashed lines, and custom arrow positions. It adapts its size to its child and works on all Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need a bubble or speech‑balloon UI element around text or other widgets
You want easy customization of border style, gradient background, or arrow direction without writing custom painters
avoid_when: You require complex animations or interactive chat‑bubble behavior
You need a full chat UI framework rather than a single container
strengths: Highly customizable appearance (border, gradient, dash, arrow direction)
Supports all Flutter platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
weaknesses: Limited to static container – no built‑in animation or interaction logic
Potential positioning bugs noted in changelog
